title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Passoff Reading 027 ]

blocks.text: Don't wish your life away making impossible plans for your future. Grand plans are fun, but not really helpful if you can't achieve them. And don't let other people pressure you into trying to achieve things that you know are not possible. You'll only worry about achieving them, and that will trigger a whole host of new anxieties. Set yourself realistic goals, and aim to achieve them one step at a time. Remember that life is precious and you need to live in the present as well as hold on to your dreams for the future.
